1001 Touch Games.name: 1001 Touch Games
1001 Touch Games.summary: Never get bored again with 1001 Touch games, the largest collection of "pick-up-and-play" interactive games available!

Ener-G - Dance Squad.name: Ener-G Dance Squad
Ener-G - Dance Squad.summary:
Become a World Class Dancer!

Play as Laura, an athletic and passionate young girl, who dreams of becoming the world champion of modern dance. With the help of her eccentric coach, she will learn new skills and soon reveal her full potential as a dancer. However, the road to victory will be full of surprises.

FIFA Soccer 09.name: FIFA Soccer 09
FIFA Soccer 09.summary: Nintendo DS port of FIFA Soccer 09.

Gummy Bears - Mini Golf.name: Gummy Bears Minigolf
Gummy Bears - Mini Golf.summary: Transport yourself to a wonderful fairy tale land full of color and cheer! Gummy Bears MiniGolf can be enjoyed by up to four friends or family members of any age, or on your own. Collect achievements, and customize nine unique holes for a personalized adventure! Come play in the fantastic world of Gummy Bears!

Imagine - Animal Doctor.name: Imagine: Animal Doctor
Imagine - Animal Doctor.summary: Imagine Animal Doctor (known as Imagine: Pet Vet in PAL regions) is a video game by Ubisoft that allows young children to take the place of a vet, take care of animals, and diagnose illnesses. This game allows the player to take care of cats, dogs, rabbits, pigs, and horses. The player of the game starts with an introduction of what you will be doing, and how to get help. The main idea is to get very well known and heal as many animals as possible. Starting with cats you will examine the different types of animals listed above then heal and return them to their owners. In return, you will gain money and proceed onto your next goal.

Master of Illusion.name: Master of Illusion
Master of Illusion.summary: Master of Illusion teaches the player how to perform selected "magic" tricks. Included with the box is a set of illusion cards which are used for many of the tricks included with the game. In all, there are over 20 illusions that you're able to learn through this software.

Ouran Koukou Host Club DS.name: Ouran High School Host Club DS
Ouran Koukou Host Club DS.summary: The Ouran High School Host Club visual novel for PlayStation 2 and Nintendo DS were developed and published by Idea Factory. The PlayStation 2 game was released in 2007 and the Nintendo DS game in 2009. Both games borrow strong elements from the dating sim genre, though classified as a "romantic adventure" game. They are currently only available in Japanese.

Powerbike.name: Powerbike
Powerbike.summary:
When your wheels hit the road, it's an adrenaline rush of raw power!

The dangerous world of street racing is about to get a whole lot more exciting! When an anonymous sponsor offers you resources to join the chaos, it’s time to take to the streets and show the amateurs how it’s done. Race for respect, personal pride, and cold, hard cash in the only motorcycle racer available for DS!

theta.name: Theta
theta.summary: Theta is a puzzle solving videogame released only in Japan that features two puzzles called "Kaiten Puzzle" and "Aquarium Puzzle". In the first one the player spins the theta-shaped wheels to move the colored spheres to the right place of the same color. In the second one the player moves the colored spheres inside the right vortex to make them disappear according to the image on the upper screen, trying not to be interrupted by other spheres of different colors attracted by the vortex.
